title: Second woman arrested, charged with murder in Taunton shooting
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Crime A 22-year-old was killed and seven others were injured when shots were fired at an outdoor party in Taunton.
Authorities arrested a second woman in connection with the Taunton shooting that killed one person and injured seven others last weekend.

Malkiah Cunningham, a 25-year-old New Bedford resident, was charged with one count of murder and seven counts of armed assault with intent to murder, according to the Bristol County District Attorney’s Office.
